changes: New: TB-3PO, a generative 303-style acid-line generator on the MIDI tracks, a port of the Phazerville TB_3PO applet through the Schwung tb3po port. Choose it in MIDI NOTE SETUP; it writes note trigs and NOTE, VEL and LEN locks that the stock sequencer plays.
SRC: DENS, ACNT, SLID, OCT, ROOT, SCAL. AMP: SEED, VAR, GATE, SLEN, AVEL, DIR; FUNC+AMP: VEL, OCTS, MOTF. A knob turn redraws the line, YES rolls a new seed.
Accents are VEL locks; slides are LEN locks reaching into the next note, so a 303-type synth slides on the overlap. Set SLEN past one step.
Needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB with MIDI generators (beta). Card firmware cannot include it.
Not yet tested on a unit or in the emulator; SLEN's default is unverified against stock's LEN table.
